  -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) FROM gasp_cost_events
     WHERE incurred_on >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND incurred_on <= DATE '2026-03-31'
       AND cost_function = 'infrastructure')
)::numeric
/ NULLIF((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue), 0) FROM gasp_financials
     WHERE period_start >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND period_start <= DATE '2026-03-31'), 0) AS gross_margin

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-03-01' AS ps, DATE '2026-03-31' AS pe
),
cac AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.cost), 0) FROM gasp_cost_events c, params p
          WHERE c.incurred_on BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe AND c.cost_function = 'gtm') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.account_ref) FROM gasp_revenue_events r, params p
              WHERE r.booked_on BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe AND r.event_type = 'new'), 0) AS v
),
arpa AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) FROM gasp_subscriptions s
          WHERE s.status = 'active'
            AND s.snapshot_day = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_day) FROM gasp_subscriptions, params p WHERE snapshot_day <= p.pe)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) FROM gasp_customers cu
              WHERE cu.lifecycle_status = 'active'
                AND cu.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM gasp_customers, params p WHERE as_of_date <= p.pe)), 0) AS v
),
gm AS (
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.revenue), 0) FROM gasp_financials f, params p WHERE f.period_start BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe)
       - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.cost), 0) FROM gasp_cost_events c, params p
          WHERE c.incurred_on BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe AND c.cost_function = 'infrastructure') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)
    / NULLIF((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.revenue), 0) FROM gasp_financials f, params p WHERE f.period_start BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe), 0) AS v
)
SELECT cac.v / NULLIF(arpa.v * gm.v, 0) AS cac_payback
FROM cac, arpa, gm
